newsitem.title: USA: Craig says to restate 1995 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Craig says to restate 1995 earnings.

text.p: Craig Consumer Electronics Inc said Monday it had discovered adjustments and accounting irregularities that require restatement downward of its earnings for the year 1995.
The effect of the adjustments and accounting irregularities is principally an overstatement of inventory and an understatement of cost of sales, it said.
The restatement will reduce previously reported net income by $763,000, or $0.32 a share, the company said.
Accordingly, the company said, it will amend its 1995 financial statements to present net income of $29,000, or $0.01 per share.
Upon discovery of the errors, which the company said arose during its 1996 audit, the company has proceeded with an investigation assisted by outside counsel and independent public accountants.
The company said it has taken administrative action on the employees involved. It said it believes the irregularities have been fully investigated and accounted for properly.
